title: DT-TEO quarantine message (v1)
description: What the ingestion gateway publishes on dt/v1/quarantine/{source} when it can't turn input into a canonical message. Pattern: EIP Invalid Message Channel (https://www.enterpriseintegrationpatterns.com/patterns/messaging/InvalidMessageChannel.html). Like a Kafka Connect dead letter queue, it keeps the ORIGINAL message untouched and adds context about the failure (https://docs.confluent.io/platform/current/installation/configuration/connect/sink-connect-configs.html). Readings that were understood but look wrong are NOT quarantined: they are published as canonical messages with quality BAD or SUSPECT.

stage.description: Where it failed. decode = the whole message couldn't be read. map = a field has no point (unknown, unbound, or its binding is disabled). normalise = the value couldn't be converted (e.g. a word not in the value map).

reason.description: Plain-English cause, e.g. "value 'DEFROST' is not in the value map for unit1.mode_status".

topic.description: The raw topic it arrived on.

source.description: From the topic: raw/{source}/..., or null if the topic couldn't be read.

device.description: From the topic: raw/{source}/{device}/..., or null.

field.description: Only for map / normalise: the field that failed, e.g. "rh".

value.description: Only for map / normalise: the field's value as decoded.

raw.description: The original payload as text (UTF-8; undecodable bytes replaced), so it can be replayed once fixed.

ingest_time.description: When the gateway received it, UTC.
